description: Use when someone wants postcards or letters printed and mailed, to one person or many. Creates an unpaid order with one piece per item, each to a single recipient: a postcard of a photo with an optional note, or a letter from text or a PDF, in black and white or colour and, within the US, as certified mail. Returns a link where the person reviews every piece and address and pays; it never charges money or mails anything. Mailed from the US: 4×6 postcards to 194 countries, 6×9 postcards within the US.

challenge.description: The id of a challenge this tool answered with, and the answers to its four questions in the order asked, each a short string. The proof-of-work question takes a few million SHA-256 hashes.

files.description: Images or PDFs uploaded or generated in this conversation, with download_url and file_id filled in by the host. Items point to them with photo_file or pdf_file.

items.description: Up to 50 pieces of mail, each to one recipient. A postcard takes one of photo_file, photo_url or photo_base64. A letter takes one of content, pdf_file, pdf_url or pdf_base64; a PDF must be US Letter portrait, at most 11 pages, and prints after a page added for the address.

note.description: The note for the back of the card, up to 350 characters.

photo_base64.description: The image file's own bytes as base64 or a data: URL. JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to about 10 MB.

photo_file.description: The position in files of this card's photo, counting from 0.

photo_url.description: A public https:// URL of an image that is already online.

recipient.description: Whatever is known of this item's one recipient; every field is optional. country is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as US.

size.description: 4x6 (the default) or 6x9. Only 4x6 can be mailed outside the US.

content.description: The letter's text, typeset on US Letter paper with the address at the top of page 1. Blank lines separate paragraphs. Up to 12 printed pages.

pdf_base64.description: A PDF file's own bytes as base64 or a data: URL.

pdf_file.description: The position in files of this letter's PDF, counting from 0.

pdf_url.description: A public https:// URL of a PDF that is already online.

printing.description: bw (black and white, the default) or color, which costs $3 more per letter.

recipient.description: Whatever is known of this item's one recipient; every field is optional. country is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as US.

service.description: standard (the default), certified, or certified_return_receipt for USPS Certified Mail with an electronic return receipt. Certified mail is US only.

order_url.description: The link of an unpaid order this tool returned earlier. The new items are added to it instead of starting a new order.

name: create_mail_order

continue_url.description: The same link as url, for agents that carry checkout on in a browser.

address.description: deliverable, corrected (a suggested address is on the review page), warning, undeliverable, incomplete or unchecked.

expected_delivery.description: Once mailed: the date USPS expects to deliver it, YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: draft or pending_payment until the person pays; paid while printing; mailed once every piece is with USPS; failed if any piece couldn't be mailed.

url.description: The link the person opens to review every piece, fix addresses and pay. It expires after about a week.

title: Create mail order
